hierarchy.notes: An adaptive GitHub-first identity surface: browser OAuth when configured, proven GitHub CLI verification otherwise, one immutable subject, explicit credential custody, and a one-time path into a later C0VIBE account without moving usage truth.

forbidden_imports: blue-check state derived from session metadata alone
allowed_side_effects: one-time same-origin C0VIBE account-link claim request

classification.notes: The browser briefly receives a Supabase access token and OAuth provider token. The provider token is sent once to the trusted link endpoint and is never persisted by this module.

ssa_v2.notes: Session derivation, provider availability, adaptive account interaction, global status, and server status lookup are separated into focused files; the largest source file is 295 lines.

ssi.notes: The console selects between the existing OAuth and GitHub CLI proof channels while both resolve to the same immutable GitHub subject and existing link contracts.

sstf.notes: Thirteen focused identity contracts and the full 662-test suite cover sanitization, redirect safety, status authorization, one-time linking, local sign-out, adaptive CLI fallback, the migration custody receipt, responsive layout, and motion safety.

spe.notes: Provider settings are fetched once, auth state is subscription-driven, and link status is a bounded same-origin request.

srs.notes: Signed-out, checking, OAuth-ready, CLI-ready, unavailable, session-only, linked, migration, avatar, route-return, identity-ledger, copy-success, copy-failure, credential custody, and later C0VIBE settings states are visible without upgrading identity into usage proof.

ssra.notes: Exact deploy 6a571905c587b6aa69ca396a and the stable domain passed enabled browser OAuth, a real github.com login redirect, CLI copy and proof-channel controls, all network requests, zero console errors, and zero horizontal overflow at 390x844, 1440x1000, and 3840x2160. The 4K surface is centered at 2640px; the earlier real GitHub CLI identity exchange remains the machine-verification proof.

sas.notes: Account, status, and contract surfaces have explicit leases and an owned-path manifest; unrelated logo work remains outside this brick.

sva.notes: The server validates bearer sessions, returns only sanitized identity fields, and neither adaptive channel persists raw GitHub credentials or infers a blue check from session metadata.

srls.notes: The status endpoint validates the user with Supabase Auth before a service-role identity lookup; anonymous status reads fail closed.

sev.notes: Public Supabase configuration is guarded client-side, the service-role key is secret-scoped in Netlify, and live invalid-token/session probes fail without returning credentials.

ssc.notes: The slice adds no dependency and reuses the existing Next, React, Supabase, and telemetry stack.

sai.notes: Intent, owned files, current-tree gates, exact deploy, real GitHub CLI exchange, provider blocker, and identity/usage boundary are captured in the Gen3 receipt and this manifest.

negative_tests: unlinked session returns no identity row

code_budget.notes: The implementation is split across the route, pure session helper, global control, server status endpoint, styles, and focused contracts.

adaptation_points: Create a dedicated GitHub OAuth app for the target Supabase callback.
Keep the GitHub provider and production redirect allowlist synchronized with the target domain.
Keep the verified GitHub CLI channel active until browser OAuth is proven live.
Retain the immutable GitHub subject as the account migration anchor.
install_steps: Copy the account, global control, browser auth, and status surfaces.
Connect the existing identity-link endpoint and Supabase environment.
Configure a dedicated OAuth provider, then rerun live auth proof.
known_traps: Do not reuse another product's OAuth credentials or callback.
Do not store provider tokens or service-role credentials in the browser.
Do not use identity verification as proof of usage volume or leaderboard tier.
